title: Cebu Pacific starts 4-day sale, fares as low as P10

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Travelers planning early for their 2027 trips may avail of discounted fares as low as P10 for a one-way trip, as Cebu Pacific, the country’s largest carrier, opens its four-day seat sale today. The 10.10 seat sale will cover travel from Feb. 1 to June 30, 2027, the airline said in a statement.
